Subject: Post-demo: budget slab confirmation & procurement path — ClearMind Analytics

Hi Marta —

Great to meet your team on the call today. Quick recap and the numbers we discussed so we have the same frame: 

Summary of ask and fit
- Primary workload: multi-turn customer support summaries + semantic search re-ranker.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~20–60M tokens / month (burst to 80M).
- Target unit economics: ClearMind said target $/1M tokens in the $350–$450 range (you mentioned $420 as a target during the demo).

Budget / procurement notes from our side
- Candidate monthly spend band: $15k — $45k/month (maps to ~20–60M tokens/month at current prompt sizes).
- Procurement threshold: PO required for commitments > $25k/month; for pilot <$25k we can accept credit card or short-term invoice.
- Volume discount: standard tier at >50M tokens/month we can apply a volume tier (details below).

What Redwood can commit to right now
- Trial proposal: 3-month pilot with a $20k/month commit (preferable for predictable capacity and prefix cache tuning).
- If ClearMind wants an aggressive unit price at scale: we can model a tier that reaches $320–$380 / 1M tokens at sustained >100M/month, or ~10% off list starting at 50M/month.

Next steps (proposed)
1) I’ll send a short mutual action plan + sample SOW and the procurement onramp playbook attached.
2) Please share PO routing contact (name + email) if you want to start procurement now — note PO path lead time typically 3–6 weeks.
3) Internal pricing review: loop in Karthik and Marcus for final unit economics and an executable quote.
4) Quick sync: can we schedule a 30-min procurement / legal touchpoint next week (suggest Wed or Thu)?

Attachments: Redwood_Sales_Deck.pdf (overview), procurement_onramp_playbook.pdf (procurement lanes + checklist)

Thanks — I’ll draft the MAP and a sample quote after you confirm the PO threshold and desired trial length.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks for the clear recap, Soojin — helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side (copied procurement):

- The $420 / 1M tokens is our internal target for negotiable pricing. That assumes decent model latency and availability for our multi-tenant service.
- On volumes: our BAU expectation is ~40–60M tokens/month, with seasonal spikes to ~90M. If we commit to a 50M+ band, is the 10% off list automatic or tied to an annual commit?
- PO question: procurement prefers to use a PO for anything above $10k/month for our vendor policy; however legal has pushed for a single PO per quarter normally. Can you confirm Redwood’s minimum PO amount and any flexibility for pilot PO structure?

Also, Marcus — could you share an example quote with tiered rates for 0–50M, 50–150M, and 150M+ tokens so we can model cost in our CFO spreadsheet?

On timing: we like the 3-month pilot idea but need to confirm with Finance this afternoon; is your team flexible to start a pilot on a shorter notice if procurement allows?

Best,
Marta
VP Product, ClearMind Analytics

Thanks Marta — all good questions. Answers below and next steps.

Pricing / volume discounts
- Price tiers (example):
  • 0–50M tokens/month = $420 / 1M tokens (pilot list rate we discussed)
  • 50–150M tokens/month = $378 / 1M tokens (~10% off list)
  • >150M tokens/month = $336 / 1M tokens (~20% off list; requires 6–12 month commit)
- The 10% at 50M is available for a sustained month-over-month run rate (we can make it automatic as soon as you cross the 50M threshold in a given billing period; for contractual guarantees we prefer a committed tier).

Procurement / PO handling
- Minimum PO for Redwood enterprise processing is typically $25k per month for multi-month commitments. For pilots under $25k/month we can accept credit card or short-term invoice while procurement finalizes a PO.
- If procurement wants a single quarterly PO, we can accommodate that structurally (we’ll need the procurement contact and the invoicing cadence).

Operational notes
- Capacity: we can reserve a dedicated pool for the pilot to keep latency predictable (this is why a modest commit is helpful).
- Security: I attached the procurement onramp playbook earlier; if you need SOC2 docs or more detailed data flow diagrams, we’ll send them once procurement indicates interest.

Next steps (action items)
1) I’ll attach the MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and a sample tiered quote for Marcus to model.
2) Marcus / Karthik will draft the formal quote and SOW; expected delivery EOD tomorrow.
3) Marta / procurement: confirm preferred PO approach and legal contact for the SOW + standard Redwood terms.
4) Schedule: tentative pilot start window: 2–3 weeks after PO/signature, or immediate if you run on CC and we do a short invoice.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP)

If you’re good with the numbers above I’ll finalize the quote and hand to finance/legal to prepare the SOW.
